behavior: MULTI_AGENT_SCHEMA_VERSION is 1 and is stamped onto every multi-agent record and index
Record ids are `${prefix}-${String(seq).padStart(4,"0")}` from collection position; prefixes mar/role/group/membership/fanout/fanin and bb/topic/msg/ctx/artifact/snapshot/decision
createMultiAgentRun mints a planned MultiAgentRun with a run-level policy, lifecycle event, state node, and trust audit event
Creating a MultiAgentRun with an existing id throws `Duplicate MultiAgentRun id: <id>`

MultiAgentRun transitions follow the fixed table planned->forming->running->collecting->verifying->completed (+failed/cancelled); bad moves throw `Invalid MultiAgentRun lifecycle transition: <from> -> <to>`
Transition to completed throws `Cannot complete MultiAgentRun <id>: ...` while any fanin is blocked/failed/not verifier-ready or a group with memberships/fanouts has no fanin
A completed MultiAgentRun cascades status completed onto owned roles/groups/fanouts/fanins that are not already terminal
createAgentRole mints a planned role with policyForRole attached and records multi-agent.role and multi-agent.role-policy audit events
createAgentGroup mints a forming group; every input taskId must exist on the run or it throws `Unknown task id for multi-agent record: <id>`

assignAgentMembership ties role+task(+worker) in a group; status running with a worker else assigned; sets the role active; duplicate combo throws `Duplicate AgentMembership for group=..., role=..., task=..., worker=...`
A role from another MultiAgentRun throws `AgentRole <id> belongs to <run-a>, not group run <run-b>`; an unknown worker throws `Unknown worker id for membership: <id>`
createAgentFanout mints a planned fanout; roleIds/taskIds default to the group's; default expectedReturnShape is the exact cw:result sentence

attachDispatchToMultiAgent needs exactly one role (`Dispatch multi-agent attach requires exactly one role for deterministic membership; found <n>`), a group, and worker ids on every task; makes memberships, sets fanout dispatched / group running / run running
recordMultiAgentWorkerOutput marks every membership matching workerId+taskId reported and merges evidence refs, artifact paths, and blackboard ids; returns [] when none match
collectAgentFanin derives coverage/missing roles/missing memberships; status ready iff no blocked reasons, else blocked with verifierReady false
Blocked reason strings are exactly `required role <id> has no membership`, `membership <id> has not reported required evidence`, `membership <id> has no indexed blackboard evidence`
When a blackboard is in scope, each required membership must carry at least one indexed blackboard message or artifact ref or the fanin blocks
A membership counts as reported only with status reported|verified AND non-empty evidenceRefs
summarizeMultiAgent returns totals, per-status counts, groupsDetail role coverage, blockedReasons, and a deterministic nextAction command
buildMultiAgentGraph emits nodes/edges with ids `<run>:multi-agent:...`, `<run>:blackboard:...`, `<run>:task:...`, `<run>:worker:...`; edges deduped by from+to+label

statusToNodeStatus maps completed|reported|ready->completed, running|forming|collecting|verifying|assigned|active|dispatched->running, blocked->blocked, failed->failed, cancelled|rejected->rejected, default pending
.cw/runs/<run>/multi-agent/{index.json, runs/, roles/, groups/, memberships/, fanouts/, fanins/} with one <safeFileName(id)>.json per record
multi-agent/index.json has schemaVersion, runId, counts{runs,roles,groups,memberships,fanouts,fanins}, and per-kind rows {id,status,updatedAt}
persist throws `<Label> ids <a> and <b> collide on safe file name <safe>` before writing when two ids map to one file name
OFFICIAL_TOPOLOGIES is exactly map-reduce, debate, judge-panel with the fixed roles, topics, phases, evidence, and decision kinds
registerTopology overwrites by id (last write wins); listTopologyDefinitions merges official + registered with registered winning; results are deep clones
validateTopologyDefinition returns issue codes unknown-topology, missing-roles, missing-groups, missing-topics, missing-evidence, unknown-phase-role with the exact messages
applyTopology materializes blackboard, topics, multi-agent run, roles, group, fanout, apply message, context-update decision, optional initial fanin, audits, then the MultiAgentTopologyRun record
Default topology-run id is `<definition.id>-<first 16 hex of sha256(stableStringify({definitionId, sorted roleIds, sorted taskIds, runId, sequence}))>`
Derived default ids: <id>-blackboard, <id>-<topic>, <id>-ma, <id>-<role>, <id>-group, <id>-fanout, <id>-fanin-initial
Role width = max(1, roleCounts[id] ?? role.count ?? 1); mapper default 2, judge default 3; mapperCount floors at 1, judgeCount floors at 2; wide roles mint `<role>-<n>` / `<Title> <n>`
Fanout excludes role ids ending -reducer, -synthesizer, -panel-chair; if that empties the list, all roles fan out; concurrencyLimit = fanout role count
ApplyTopologyInput.debateRounds is accepted on CLI/MCP/host but never read by applyTopology; debate always mints one instance per role
With no taskIds, apply picks the first pending task, else the first task; unknown ids throw `Unknown task id for topology: <id>`
Topology run status is blocked iff the initial fanin blocked, else planned; missingEvidence = fanin blockedReasons or the definition requiredEvidence
nextActions are exactly the dispatch --multi-agent-fanout, multi-agent fanin <id>-fanin --fanout, and topology summary command strings
summarizeTopologies derives status ready|blocked from live fanins, readiness string `fanin ready`|`missing evidence`|`awaiting worker output`, and the candidate-register next action when ready
.cw/runs/<run>/topologies/{index.json, runs/<topology-run-id>.json}; index rows are {id,topologyId,status,updatedAt}
showTopologyRun throws `Unknown topology run id: <id>`
resolveBlackboard finds by id, else by multiAgentRunId link, else the first board, else creates bb-NNNN with status active; always back-links multi-agent records
createBlackboardTopic mints topic-NNNN with status open and joins it to the board; records topic + blackboard.write audits

postBlackboardMessage requires a non-blank body (`Blackboard message body is required`) and an existing replyTo (`Unknown parent BlackboardMessage id: <id>`); builds provenance with bodyHash sha256:<hex> and locator <board>/messages/<id>
Agent-scoped authors (role/group/membership/worker, or agent-linked writes) pass assertMultiAgentActionAllowed before the message/context/artifact exists; denial throws and leaves state unchanged
A context with the same board+topic+kind+key, not superseded, and a different value marks BOTH records conflicting and records a conflict-resolution decision with outcome conflicting
supersedesContextIds marks each old record superseded with supersededByContextId set to the new id
A `question` context starts with status open; other kinds active; conflicting wins over both

addBlackboardArtifact needs path or locator (`Blackboard artifact requires --path or --locator`), resolves the path absolute, checksums existing files as sha256:<hex>, and records an artifact-index decision `Indexed <kind> artifact <id>`
createBlackboardSnapshot stores sorted topic/message/context/artifact/decision id lists plus an embedded summary
recordCoordinatorDecision derives record status from outcome (conflicting|blocked->conflicting, rejected->rejected, superseded->superseded, else active) and audits kind coordinator.decision
A decision of kind candidate-synthesis or tag panel-decision also records a judge.panel-decision audit event
readyForFanin is true only with a board, zero open questions, zero conflicts, >=1 artifact, and zero missing-evidence rows; rows read `question|context <id> has no indexed evidence` sorted
summarizeBlackboard nextAction is one of the four exact cw command strings (topic create / coordinator decision / message post / artifact add) else `blackboard snapshot`
.cw/runs/<run>/blackboard/{index.json, messages.jsonl, topics/, contexts/, artifacts/, snapshots/, decisions/}
messages.jsonl is rewritten whole on each persist: one JSON message per line sorted by createdAt then id, trailing newline only when non-empty
normalizeAuthor: runtime/coordinator id defaults to `cw`, operator to `operator`; other kinds without an id throw `Blackboard author requires an explicit id`
Record metadata passes a recursive scrub: keys matching /secret|token|password|credential|authorization|api[_-]?key|env/i and values matching /secret|token|password|credential/i become `[redacted]`

policyForRole: substring chair|reducer|synthesizer grants snapshot/coordinator-decision writes, candidate score+select, judge rationale+panel-decision; substring judge grants verdict+rationale; others get score only
requiredEvidenceFor is fixed: judge.rationale, judge.verdict, judge.panel-decision, candidate.select each list their required evidence labels
authorizeMultiAgentAction resolves the policy membership -> role -> group; none found denies with `missing role authority or policy`

Denial reasons are the exact strings for topic scope, candidate/judge/write op outside policy, and `operation <op> requires evidence refs: <refs>`; allowed reason is `allowed by explicit multi-agent policy`
Every denial records a multi-agent.permission (denied) event plus a policy.violation event chained by parentEventIds
assertMultiAgentActionAllowed throws the decision reason string on denial
A judge.rationale/panel-decision audit is accepted only with non-empty evidenceRefs AND a rationale; rationale metadata is cut to 240 chars
hasAcceptedJudgeRationale matches accepted judge.rationale events; an event with no scoreId matches any scoreId filter
sourceForActor: none->operator-recorded, worker->host-attested, operator->operator-recorded, runtime|coordinator|verifier->runtime-derived, else cw-validated

summarizeMultiAgentTrust buckets audit events into rolePolicies, permissionDecisions, blackboardWrites, messageProvenance, judgeRationales, panelDecisions, policyViolations with the audit policy/multi-agent next action
registerCandidate is idempotent per id; default id candidate-<kind>-<seed>-NNNN; kind inferred workerId->worker-output, resultNodeId/resultPath->result, else manual; status registered
total = sum(criteria); maxTotal default max(total,1); normalized = clamp(total/maxTotal,0,1); verdict pass>=0.7, warn>=0.4, else fail; below minNormalized always fail
With requireEvidence (default true) and no evidence, scoring records feedback code candidate-score-missing-evidence, sets the candidate failed, and throws `Candidate <id> score requires evidence`
Candidate status becomes failed on a fail verdict else scored; score id is score-<candidateId>-NNNN

rankCandidates excludes rejected unless includeRejected, sorts normalized desc with tieBreaker createdAt (default; then id) or candidateId, ranks 1-based, detects ties by equal normalized, writes ranking.json

selectCandidate fails closed with codes candidate-not-selectable, candidate-selection-missing-verifier, candidate-selection-missing-evidence, candidate-selection-empty-capture, candidate-selection-score-below-threshold, review-gate-missing-approvals; failures become feedback, the candidate goes failed, and the joined messages are thrown
Selection and the commit gate share one emptyCaptureWarning, so an empty-capture verifier node is unselectable and uncommittable for the same reason

On pass the selection id is selection-<candidateId>-NNNN, candidate status verified (verifier verified) or selected, selectedBy default operator, reason default `selected candidate`, plus a candidate.selection audit and acceptance rationale
rejectCandidate sets status rejected with feedback code candidate-rejected; record stays on disk
candidate.json and score files are validated (validateCandidateRecord/validateCandidateScore) before entering memory; corrupt files throw
.cw/runs/<run>/candidates/{index.json, ranking.json, <candidate-id>/candidate.json, <candidate-id>/scores/<score-id>.json, selections/<selection-id>.json}
mergePolicy defaults: id cw.candidate.default, title Default Candidate Scoring, requireEvidence true, requireVerifierGate true, tieBreaker createdAt; policy.criteria is intentionally not emitted
An absent actor id becomes the exact UNATTRIBUTED_ACTOR record, never a made-up identity
recordApproval appends collab-approval-NNNN / collab-rejection-NNNN (one shared counter over approvals array length) with a trust audit event; never mutates old records
recordComment requires a body (`Comment body is required`), default threadId <kind>:<id>, id collab-comment-NNNN
recordHandoff requires a to-actor (`Handoff requires a to-actor (--to)`); the newest run/task handoff's toActor is the derived owner
setReviewPolicy defaults: requiredApprovals 0, authorizedRoles ["*"], allowSelfApproval false, requireAttestedActor false, appliesTo ["commit"]
deriveReviewState counts only distinct, attested-enough, authorized, non-self, non-superseded approvals; a veto rejects; status approved|rejected|pending|blocked|unattributed by the fixed rules
reviewGateErrors returns [] when not gated/approved else one error code review-gate-missing-approvals with message `Review gate blocked (<status>): <missing>`
commitReviewProvenance stamps {policyId, requiredApprovals, recordedApprovals, approvers, sorted approvalIds, target} only when the gated target is approved
Targets must be one of run|task|candidate|selection|commit|node with an id; else `Collaboration target requires a kind and id` / `Unknown collaboration target kind: <kind>`
formatReviewStatus prints the exact `review <run> policy=...`, owner, counts, per-target status, missing notes, and timeline layout
formatCommentList prints `no comments` or one `<createdAt>  <actor> (<attestation>)  [<kind> <id>]  <body>` line per comment
multi-agent run attaches to the active same-id topology (performed attached-topology) or applies one (applied-topology); never dispatches workers
multi-agent status returns the host envelope (state, ids, paths, summaries, nextActions) without side effects

multi-agent step performs at most one deterministic action in the fixed order: fanin -> dispatch manifest -> blackboard snapshot -> register candidate -> score -> select; terminal/blocked states return performed none with a requiredHostAction

multi-agent blackboard supports summary|board|topics|list-topics|messages|list-messages|post|message|artifacts|list-artifacts|add-artifact|artifact|context|put-context|snapshot; unknown action throws the exact usage string
multi-agent score needs explicit evidence and a resolvable candidate; with role/membership authority it also needs a rationale and the judge.rationale permission
multi-agent select picks the explicit/single/top-ranked candidate; with role/membership authority it needs an accepted judge rationale and the candidate.select permission

Every host response is the MultiAgentHostResponse envelope: schemaVersion 1, surface multi-agent-host, command, runId, state, performed, nextAction(s), blockedReasons, requiredHostAction, evidenceRequirements, ids{13 lists}, paths{8}, summaries{9}, data

classifyHostState order: needs-run, failed (non-retryable feedback), blocked (open feedback), complete, ready-for-commit, ready-for-selection, ready-for-scoring, awaiting-worker-output, ready-for-scoring (verified worker), ready-for-fanin, ready-for-dispatch, blocked
hostNextActions returns the exact per-state cw command strings; a requiredHostAction collapses to one {command: host-action, priority: high} row
More than one active topology throws `Ambiguous active topology state: <ids>`; ambiguous boards/topics throw the matching exact strings
hostStep scoring falls back to criteria {correctness:1, evidence:1, fit:1} with maxTotal 3 and scorer multi-agent-host
step dispatch sandbox profile defaults to `readonly` (aliases sandbox|sandboxProfile|sandboxProfileId)
--criterion name=value entries (or a criteria object, or --total) build the score criteria; none -> `Missing score criteria. Use --criterion name=value`

hostRun reads topology|topologyId|id, mapperCount|mapper-count|mappers|mapper, judgeCount|judge-count|judges|judge, debateRounds|debate-rounds|rounds, collectInitialFanin|collect-initial-fanin, task|taskId|tasks
summarizeMultiAgentOperator returns schemaVersion 1, sorted id lists, blocked = failures>0, dependencies, failures, evidence (+missing/adopted/inspectable splits), nextAction, and 4 nested summaries

Failure rows use the fixed kind set (missing-role-coverage, agent-membership, missing-worker, worker-output, fanin, missing-role-evidence, missing-membership-evidence, missing-topology-evidence, candidate-score-gap, candidate-verifier-gap, selection, commit-gate, ...) each with an exact reason and next command
Evidence rows normalize: any rejectedBy -> rejected; adoptedBy -> adopted unless missing/conflicting/superseded; sort by status rank adopted<pending<missing<conflicting<rejected<superseded then id
disposition = adopted, else blocking when status is missing|pending|conflicting AND no verifier-gated commit exists, else inspectable

formatMultiAgentOperatorStatus prints the fixed panels (header, Agent Graph, Dependencies, Failed / Blocked Agents, Adopted Evidence, Missing Evidence, Next Action) with row caps 80/40/60 and `... N more` tails; empty panels print `  none`
With inspectable rows the Missing Evidence header becomes `Missing Evidence (blocking=<n>, inspectable=<n>; a verifier-gated commit decided the selection — inspectable rows are not failures)`
Operator graph relabels: none->depends-on, blackboard|task->depends-on, dispatch->dispatches, reported|result|message->reports, evidence->cites; nodes sorted by kind then id, edges deduped and sorted
eval snapshot writes snapshot.json (kind multi-agent-replay-snapshot, default id <run-id>-snapshot) and suite.json under <cwd>/.cw/evals/<suite-id>/
eval replay RE-DERIVES the projection from the baseline run state via loadRunStateFile + normalizeRun and writes replay-run.json (status completed, errors []); it never copies snapshot.normalized
eval compare checks all 31 sections by replayStableStringify equality and writes comparison.json + findings.json; each miss is finding regression-<section> severity error
eval score gives 1 point per metric, status pass iff none fail, and writes score.json; a stale/missing comparison is recomputed
eval gate requires snapshot/replay-run/comparison/score files, rejects stale artifacts with the exact error strings, and writes gate.json with verdict ship|hold
eval report writes report.md with the fixed `# Multi-Agent Eval Replay Report` section layout and `- <metric>: <status> - <reason>` lines
The metric ids are the exact 22 required + 6 state-explosion + 3 reasoning ids in the declared order
normalizeValue sorts keys, drops createdAt/updatedAt/recordedAt/selectedAt/replayedAt/generatedAt, and scrubs path-like keys; scrub regexes produce <timestamp>, <run-dir>, <eval-dir>, <tmp>
lines() maps entries through replayStableStringify and sorts the string array, so record order never affects parity

Replay throws `Cannot re-derive replay projection: baseline run state missing at <path>; re-snapshot from a live run before replaying.` (or the unsupported variant) instead of falling back to the baseline copy
Snapshot/replay loading validates kind and shape with the exact `Not a replay snapshot: <path>` / `Replay run missing ...` error strings; only the 22 base sections are required
Pre-0.1.25/0.1.26 snapshots load with the optional summary/reasoning sections treated as [] in comparison
.cw/evals/<suite-id>/ holds suite.json, snapshot.json, replay-run.json, comparison.json, findings.json, score.json, gate.json, report.md, replay/
collectCandidateScores reads candidates/<id>/scores/<scoreId>.json and records {candidateId, scoreId, missing: true} when the file is gone
formatMultiAgentEval renders the fixed Eval Suite / Replay Status / ... / Final Verdict / Next Action panels per artifact shape, with `<metric>=<status>` items joined by `; `

A directory target resolves to <dir>/snapshot.json or <dir>/replay-run.json; a non-existing target falls back to process.cwd()/.cw/evals/<safeFileName(target)>/...; empty target throws `Missing eval target`
All record JSON is written atomic (temp + rename) as JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) plus a trailing newline; messages.jsonl is the one plain rewrite
Record file names pass safeFileName (replace /[^a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]+/g with _); the operator-UX module has its own variant that also replaces `:`
The kernel/coordinator unique() sorts (persisted id arrays are sorted); the topology/candidate/host unique() copies keep insertion order
cw_multi_agent_run/status/step/blackboard/score/select return the same host envelope as the CLI --json output (parity-gated)
cw_multi_agent_summary/graph, cw_multi_agent_*_show, and the create/transition/collect write tools mirror the kernel functions
cw_topology_list/show/validate/apply/summary/graph mirror the topology functions; no CLI-only topology behavior
cw_blackboard_summary/graph/resolve/topic_create/message_post/message_list/context_put/artifact_add/artifact_list/snapshot and cw_coordinator_summary/decision mirror the coordinator functions
cw_eval_snapshot/replay/compare/score/gate/report return deterministic JSON with artifact paths
cw_audit_multi_agent/policy/role/blackboard/judge expose the trust projections
cw_multi_agent_graph/dependencies/failures/evidence expose the operator model; cw_multi_agent_status embeds it under summaries.multiAgentOperator
Old runs without multiAgent/blackboard/topologies state normalize to empty arrays with schemaVersion 1; unknown user data is kept
Collaboration records persist only inside state.json via saveCheckpoint; there is no collaboration directory
No module in this subsystem calls process.exit; failures are thrown Errors that the CLI wrapper maps to a non-zero exit with the message on stderr
